name: Mamemon
main_effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. You may play 1 Tamer card with a play cost of 4 or less among them without paying the cost. Place the rest at the top or bottom of your deck in any order.
source_effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When you play another Digimon by an effect, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) until the end of your opponent's turn.
